close_reason: All four deterministic automation and recovery stories are implemented. Focused Jidoka and CLI verification passed: 66 Jidoka tests and 46 CLI phase tests.
description:
# Phase outcome

Automation maturity. Entry: stable sequence, evidence, trust, and limits. Exit: offline replay, bounded admission, and explicit partial artifact state are available.

# Ranked child stories

1. `jido_cli-tqg.6.1` — Record and replay deterministic capability fixtures (P2)
2. `jido_cli-tqg.6.2` — Expose replay through trusted automation profiles (P2)
3. `jido_cli-tqg.6.3` — Enforce bounded runtime limits and provider-aware admission (P2)
4. `jido_cli-tqg.6.4` — Finalize partial artifact directories after interruption (P2)

# Status rule

All child stories remain open. Story dependency links, not priority alone, control implementation order.
title: Phase 5: Improve deterministic automation and recovery
